scenes.title: The README Gate
scenes.text: October rain taps the monitor as you stumble through a README-shaped archway. A sign says: FIRST-TIME CONTRIBUTORS, PLEASE DO NOT PANIC. Somewhere in the repository, your first pull request is waiting to be merged before Hacktoberfest ends.

choices.text: Follow a flickering green build light

scenes.title: The Lobby of Issues
scenes.text: Issue labels drift like bats: good first issue, help wanted, and one ominous label reading WONTFIX. A ghostly maintainer watches from a ticket queue.

choices.text: Ask the maintainer ghost for directions
Slip through a door labeled CI

scenes.title: The Terminal of Echoes
scenes.text: A terminal whispers your own typo back at you. Beneath it lies a lantern, helpfully labeled DEBUG LIGHT. It is surprisingly warm.

scenes.title: The Foggy Graveyard of Stale Branches
scenes.text: Branches poke from the fog like crooked headstones: feature/final-final-2 and actually-done-this-time. Merge-conflict monsters growl between them.

choices.text: Light the fog with your lantern
Let the branches have your username

scenes.title: The Archive of Forgotten Docs
scenes.text: Dusty documentation floats in midair. A brass repository key rests inside a box labeled DOCUMENTATION IS CODE TOO. A map points to an attic and a creaking CI machine.

choices.text: Use the repository key to open the attic
Read the map to the workshop
Walk into the CI machine room

scenes.title: The Patch Workshop
scenes.text: Tools clatter by themselves. On a workbench sits a tiny pull request with your name on it. It needs a badge, a review, and perhaps fewer TODOs.

choices.text: Ask the ghost for a review
Polish the patch in the attic
Feed the patch to the CI machine

scenes.title: The Attic of Unresolved TODOs
scenes.text: Cobwebs connect ancient TODO comments. Behind one, you find a contributor badge and a golden commit message: fix: definitely not haunted. The commit glows with suspiciously good lint.

choices.text: Hide under a TODO and wait

scenes.title: The Grumpy Maintainer Ghost
scenes.text: "Did you read CONTRIBUTING.md?" the ghost booms. You nod. The ghost sighs, reviews your diff, and produces a contributor badge from one transparent sleeve.

choices.text: Accept the badge and promise small commits
Argue that tests are a suggestion

scenes.title: The Creaking CI Pipeline
scenes.text: A giant machine coughs up warnings. Its conveyor belt is labeled BUILD, TEST, LINT, and PLEASE DO NOT PUSH TO MAIN. One green light flickers.

scenes.title: The Merge-Conflict Monster
scenes.text: A monster made of red diffs blocks the conveyor. It demands that you resolve HEAD and incoming changes, preferably without choosing both sides of the same line.

scenes.title: The Pull Request Drawbridge
scenes.text: The drawbridge to main lowers. Checks pass, the maintainer ghost hovers, and the repository asks one final question: are you ready to click MERGE?

choices.text: Use the golden commit's secret rune
Close the tab and pretend this was a dream

scenes.title: A Green Check in the Dark
scenes.text: Your pull request is merged! The ghost gives a tiny approving nod, the CI machine purrs, and Hacktoberfest gains one brave new contributor.

scenes.title: The Repository Claims Another Branch
scenes.text: The fog closes over your branch. Somewhere, a merge-conflict monster adds a comment: looks good to me (it does not). The repository will still be here next October.

scenes.title: The Maintainer's Hidden Shortcut
scenes.text: The golden commit reveals a secret path: your PR merges, the ghost smiles, and the repository unlocks a hidden achievement for immaculate commit messages.
